opening_analysis.diagnosis: The opening is a title and a set of UI instructions, not a narrative or argumentative hook. There is no thesis or problem statement in the visible content. The reader is immediately presented with interface elements (Redraw, Download PNG) rather than an engaging entry into the subject.

logical_gaps: No explanation of what Theophysics is or why a visual sketch is needed.
No connection between the UI instructions and the 'Related Work' section.
unresolved_tensions: The document presents as a tool interface but also claims to be a 'Visual Sketch Explainer' — the purpose is unclear.

missing_bridges: Between the UI instructions and the 'Related Work' section.
Between the title and the first content block.
flow.suggested_reorder: Move the UI instructions (Redraw, Download PNG, Template, Custom Title) to the end or a sidebar. Begin with a brief explanation of the visual sketch and its purpose.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: The document is titled 'Theophysics Blackboard' and includes a visual sketch explainer.
paragraph_function_map.problem: The title is present but no explanatory text follows; the reader is left without context.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: The user can redraw or download the sketch as a PNG.
paragraph_function_map.problem: UI instructions interrupt the conceptual flow. They should be separated from the main content.
Technical specifications are not relevant at the start of a conceptual document.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: Clicking 'Redraw' generates a fresh sketch variation.
paragraph_function_map.problem: Repetitive UI instruction; adds no conceptual value.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: The document includes a 'Related Work' section.
paragraph_function_map.problem: No transition from the UI instructions to this section; feels abrupt.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: Related Work includes core article, supporting evidence, and broader context.
paragraph_function_map.problem: Too vague; does not specify what the core article is or how to access it.

rearrangement_suggestions: Move all UI instructions (paragraphs 2-4) to the end or a separate sidebar.
Add an introductory paragraph before the title that explains the purpose of the visual sketch.
Merge the 'Related Work' section with a brief description of the core article and its relevance.
top_3_fixes: Add a clear thesis or problem statement in the first paragraph to orient the reader.
Remove or relocate UI instructions to avoid interrupting the conceptual flow.
Expand the 'Related Work' section with specific references and links to the core article.
